headline: Tens of thousands of people protest in Portugal over rapidly rising housing prices
summary: Large demonstrations against rapidly rising housing prices were held on 14 November in more than 30 cities and towns across Portugal, with people of different ages taking part.
why: Housing affordability affects consumer spending, mortgage lending, and political pressure on property policy, which matter to banks and real estate investors.
